subject: MedLytics RFP — request for evaluation credit escrow and handoff
messages:
From: Sam Walker <sam.walker@medlytics.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 24 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask on additional eval credits + escrow for RFP bake-off

Neha — thanks again for the demo yesterday. The execs had a few follow-ups after the tech deep dive. Short version: MedLytics is running a head-to-head RFP with two other vendors next month. We need to run full-stack benchmarks (up to 2M tokens total across tests) and want the results to be reproducible for procurement.

Ask: can Redwood provide a temporary eval credit uplift (approx. $12k equivalent) plus an escrow mechanism so the trial can't be exhausted by background traffic? The procurement team also wants an audit trail + a mutual action plan (MAP) tying usage to scoring windows. Attached is the latest RFP scope.

Thanks — Sam

Sam Walker
Head of AI Ops, MedLytics
Sam.Walker@medlytics.com
Attachments: MedLytics_RFP_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Sam Walker <sam.walker@medlytics.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask on additional eval credits + escrow for RFP bake-off

Sam — appreciate the context and congrats on getting the bake-off to the exec level. I'm copying Ben from Commercial Ops so we can scope an approved credit uplift and the operational constraints (escrow / dedicated sandbox / access controls).

Couple clarifying Qs before Ben and I route to RevOps for a MAP:
- Are the 2M tokens estimated across a 2-week window or over the full PoC period?
- Will the benchmark traffic be IP-restricted to your test harness, or do you need Redwood to provision a dedicated token-limited key?

If you can confirm those two things today, I'll push a draft MAP and credit proposal back by EOD Monday.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, Sam Walker <sam.walker@medlytics.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 11:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask on additional eval credits + escrow for RFP bake-off

Looping in operational constraints and approval parameters. TL;DR — we can do a timeboxed credit uplift + access-limited key, but we need RevOps sign-off on the MAP and a policy for escrowed usage. Suggested guardrails:

1) Credit uplift: $12,000 in trial credits, valid for 21 days from activation.
2) Escrow model: equal parts — we reserve the uplift on the customer's account and enable a scoped API key that can only be used from specified source IPs or with HMAC-signed client tokens.
3) Usage reporting: hourly consumption logs + token-level attribution window per test run.
4) Contingency: if abnormal background traffic is detected (>= 20% of uplift in 3 hours), we pause and notify procurement and account team.

Marissa — can you confirm this is within MAP policy for a competitive bake-off? If not, what paperwork/DocuSign do we need?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: ben.carter@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask on additional eval credits + escrow for RFP bake-off

Ben / Neha — ok to approve with conditions. We require:
1) Signed MAP (template attached) that includes acceptance criteria and scoring windows.
2) A signed usage escrow addendum (short form) that authorizes Redwood to hold the uplift in a reserved pool until test window opens.
3) Customer to provide list of test harness IPs and one designated test owner.

Operational notes: RevOps will provision a dedicated API key with a vaulted token (no UI-visible balance) and enable hourly reporting to the HubSpot deal. DocuSign templates: "MAP-RFP" and "Escrow-Addendum" — once signed, I'll kick off provisioning (target SLA: 24 hours).

Attaching the MAP template for Neha to share with Sam.

Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)

From: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Sam Walker <sam.walker@medlytics.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 27 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask on additional eval credits + escrow for RFP bake-off

Sam — great news: we can support the uplift and escrow. Next steps:

1) Please confirm the two items Ben asked about (2M tokens window + harness IPs).
2) Review and sign the MAP + escrow addendum (DocuSign link below). We need both signed to provision the reserved credits.
3) Once signed, RevOps (Marissa) will provision a dedicated API key scoped to your IPs and enable hourly usage exports to the HubSpot deal.

DocuSign (MAP + Escrow addendum): https://docusign.net/TP-abc123
HubSpot deal link (for internal tracking): https://hubspot.com/deal/MLX-2026-0821

If you can turn this around by EOD Monday we'll provision credits the next business day and timebox them for the 21-day scoring window.

—Neha
